name: Top Bar Swipe
description:
Animated, colored swipe bars across the top panel that react to notifications, charger and Bluetooth events, or run as a calm ambient loop.

Per-app colors, directions and stroke counts are configurable in Preferences. Notification rules match only the app name and title, never the message body.

Optional (off by default): a panel button or keyboard shortcut that runs shell commands you configure yourself in Preferences and shows their output. No commands are run unless you add them.
